text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —My throat is parched.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yearning for the passion to take that next 
new step. A thirst to keep running even 
further.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"It is that very unfulfillable wish that 
keeps driving me forward."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Telling me to live—to run—even more.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Because this was a place where that could 
come true.

Narita Brian brilliantly succeeded in 
leaving her mark on the Twinkle Series.

Together, we made it through those truly 
precious "first three years"—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I finished the hill climb.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian-san! Do you have a moment for 
an interview?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
choice_data_list: Leave dealing with the press to me

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Mm.

While the trend had already begun before 
the Arima Kinen, public expectations for 
Narita Brian were growing even higher.

Considering what she has achieved, it's 
completely understandable, but having to 
deal with interviews every single time 
must be exhausting.
choice_data_list: Maybe I should hold a press conference.
Maybe I'll hold a press conference.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hooh. That certainly seems more efficient.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh... I'll leave the specifics to you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I should prepare a comment for now as 
well.

And so, it was decided that we would set 
up a joint press conference for multiple 
media outlets.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Brian-san! How confident are you about 
being selected as this year's URA Horse of 
the Year!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian-san, please tell us about 
your future outlook!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
"A rival!! Brian-san, who is your current 
rival right now!?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: One question at a time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
First off, regarding "Umamusume of the 
Year"... Dunno. Isn't that for you guys to 
decide?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I will simply keep running wherever my 
heart leads. I suppose this will also 
affect the outlook ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Now then, as for your rivals...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
My rivals are every single Umamusume who 
lives in the world of racing.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
And not just Hishi Amazon-san and Biwa 
Hayahide-san?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, anyone is welcome to challenge 
me. And in turn, I will face whoever steps 
up with all my might.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm gunning for every single one of their 
heads, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: And also...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: ...And?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I've got a question for you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Can I cross the ocean and challenge races 
over there while still remaining enrolled 
here?
choice_data_list: You mean taking on an overseas challenge?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: N-N-N-No way! Brian-san, you're...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Didn't I tell you before? My rivals are 
"every single Umamusume living in the 
racing world."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm not moving my base of operations 
overseas. There are still plenty of rivals 
to compete against in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Still, stopping at just the Twinkle Series 
would be a shame. I want to go out and 
challenge myself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"As long as there are opponents beyond 
this country, too. ...Right, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: Got it, I'll make the adjustments.

text_block_list.name: Press Corps
text_block_list.text: Oooohh!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Very well, we shall proceed with that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that turned out to be an interesting 
press conference.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
They're all things that had to be said 
eventually, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of everything, I'm grateful to 
you.
choice_data_list:
Preparing for a press conference is a 
piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh, that's not all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hey! Brian!! Time for our showdown today!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Maya too, Maya too!! Race with me too!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like those two are here. Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Please, keep letting me run, forever and 
always.
